description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 seqret: the sequences of a file are read by the sequence readers of the EMBOSS library (ajseqread.c) and written in FASTA (with the GFF3 or another feature format of the features the file carries). Input formats read byte for byte as the installed program reads them (200 inputs of each of 49 names, with the library's warnings and errors): fasta (ncbi, pearson, gifasta, dbid), gcg (gcg8), embl (em), swiss (sw, swissprot, uniprot; the DE description of RecName / AltName / SubName / Includes / Contains / Flags is assembled as the library does), nbrf (pir), genbank (gb, ddbj, refseq), refseqp, genpept, codata, strider, ig, igstrict, iguspto, staden, textonly (plain, asis, unknown), fastq, fastq-sanger, fastq-illumina, fastq-solexa, sam, gff2, gff3 (gff; the sequence after ##FASTA / the ##DNA lines), gde, raw, and the alignment formats clustal (aln), msf, fitch, mase, biomart, treecon, acedb (the members of the alignment are returned one after the other). With no format every format the program tries is tried in turn (a text no format reads is read as plain text). The features of embl, genbank, refseq, refseqp, swiss, nbrf, gff2 and gff3 files are returned with featureFormat when feature is true. Not read yet (phylip, phylipnon, nexus, mega, selex, stockholm, hennig86, jackknifer, ace, experiment, pdb and the binary abi, bam, nibble, scf, das, ensembl): the tool refuses an input of such a format. A5-8c3g, B09 F248.

sequence.description: The text of the sequence file (any input format above), or a sequence as letters. A value 'asis::ACGT' is the sequence itself.

sequenceFormat.description: The input format (-sformat): the names above, any case, or an EDAM term; default: the program finds the format.

feature.description: Read and write the features of the sequences (-feature).

featureFormat.description: The feature output format (-offormat2): gff3 (default), gff, gff2, bed, embl, em, genbank, gb, ddbj, refseq, refseqp, pir, nbrf, swiss, sw, swissprot, uniprot, dasgff, draw, debug.

qualifiers.description: Sequence input qualifiers as typed after the sequence on the command line: -slower1 -supper1 -snucleotide1 -sprotein1 (also -sformat1 F); the range qualifiers are not applied by this tool yet.

files.description: More files by name (file name -> text) that sequence may name with a 'format::' prefix.

sequenceText.description: The text of the sequence output file (FASTA).

featureText.description: The text of the feature output file (empty when no feature was written).

messages.description: What the library printed on its error stream (Warning: ..., Error: ...), in order.

errors.message: Invalid arguments (an empty sequence, a text no sequence reader reads - 'Unable to read sequence' -, an input of an alignment or binary format this port does not read, an input on which the reference program dies by a fault).

examples.name: A Swiss-Prot entry with its description and features
